name: Melbourne, Australia 🇦🇺
subtitle: World's most liveable — and most obsessive — food city
items: Attica (Ben Shewry, Ripponlea, World's 50 Best — indigenous Australian ingredients, philosophical cooking)
Lune Croissanterie (Fitzroy + CBD, Kate Reid — possibly the world's best croissant, 2-hr queue)
Vue de Monde (Shannon Bennett, Rialto Tower — views + modern Australian, the grand occasion)
Supernormal (Andrew McConnell, Flinders Lane — Japanese-Australian, the lobster roll + prawn toast)
Chin Chin (Flinders Lane, Chris Lucas — always-packed Thai, no reservations)
Grossi Florentino (CBD, Guy Grossi, 3 floors, since 1900s — the Italian institution)
Flower Drum (CBD, 1975, Gilbert Lau — the Cantonese table Melbourne built its identity around)
Embla (CBD, Dave Verheul, natural wine + fire-cooked — the natural wine mecca)
Cumulus Inc. (Flinders Lane, Andrew McConnell — brunch + all day)
Minamishima (Richmond, Koichi Minamishima — the sushi omakase)
Tipo 00 (City North, Andreas Papadakis — handmade pasta, best in Melbourne)
Anchovy (Richmond, Thi Le, Vietnamese fine dining — 1 hat)
Lee Ho Fook (CBD, Victor Liong, modern Chinese — 2-hat)
Hardware Société (CBD, the brunch institution — croissant + egg dishes)
St Ali (South Melbourne, the coffee original — world-class espresso since 2005)
Bistro Thierry (Armadale, classic French bistro — the locals' escape)
Bar Lourinhã (CBD, Matt McConnell, Portuguese)
Rice Paper Scissors (CBD, Southeast Asian street food + bar)
Rumi (Brunswick East, Joseph Abboud, Lebanese — the MENA institution)
Marion Wine Bar (Fitzroy, natural wine, cheese, charcuterie)
